section.title: Clone Repository
section.p: Clones a remote repository into a new local folder. After the clone operation finishes, the cloned repository becomes the current working copy.

dlentry.dd: Git menu and the Ellipsis menu in the Git Staging view toolbar.
Remote repository URL, checkout branch, and destination path.
Specify a branch only when you do not want to clone the repository default branch.

section.title: Open Repository or Select Working Copy
section.p: Selects an existing local Git repository as the current working copy.

dlentry.dd: Open repository... in the Git menu, or the Browse button next to the Working copy combo box in the Git Staging view.
The selected local folder. The folder must be a Git repository.
The Git Client uses the selected repository for actions in the Git Staging view and most Git menu actions.
When a working copy is opened, the Git Client can detect outdated local branches in the background.

section.title: Create Repository in Project
section.p: Creates a Git repository in the current project folder.

dlentry.dd: Git menu and the Ellipsis menu in the Git Staging view toolbar.
The project folder loaded in the Project view.
Enabled when the project folder is not already part of a Git repository.
The new repository can be used as a local-only repository. If you later push or pull changes, the Git Client prompts you for the remote repository URL.

section.title: Create Repository Here
section.p: Creates a Git repository in the selected folder.

dlentry.dd: Git submenu in the Project view contextual menu.
Available when the selected folder is not already part of a local Git repository.

section.title: Show Working Copy In
section.p: Opens a submenu for opening the current working copy folder in the system file manager or in a terminal window.

dlentry.dd: Git menu and the Ellipsis menu in the Git Staging view toolbar.
The working copy folder opens outside .
